Mihsab — calculator platform

An Arabic-first web platform of 21 everyday calculators in four categories — money, cars, travel and lifestyle — including zakat, VAT, salary and loan calculators.

The problem

Everyday calculations that depend on local rules — zakat, VAT, social-insurance deductions, fuel prices — need a tool that applies those rules and works in Arabic as well as English.

What it does

  • 21 calculators grouped into money, cars, travel and lifestyle, with search across all of them.
  • Arabic and English versions with right-to-left and left-to-right layouts.
  • Calculation logic kept separate from the interface and covered by automated unit tests.
  • Accepts Arabic-Indic digits in number fields.
  • Results can be shared through the page address; static assets are cached for offline use.
